{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Blue Flame''' was a military symbol for outsiders in the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] society. A [[Color/Legends|blue]] piping worn on their military uniforms, in contrast with [[Red Flame (symbol)|Red Flame]], reminded them that they could never be a Chiss. When [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jagged Fel]] of the [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy]] had been first issued a uniform with this symbol, he wrongly assumed it was a way of intergrating a Human with Chiss [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]], soon learning otherwise.<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Jagged Fel would come to wear the Red Flame.<ref name="DTII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>
